name: Ezekiel
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return

points: This was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity, when the word of the Most High came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans, and the hand of the Most High was upon him.

note.label: Ezekiel 1: The Vision by the River Chebar

points: “Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign”.
